steps.name: Agitated Creature
steps.text: Found it?

steps.name: Dozy Creature
steps.text: Found it, found it.

steps.name: Dozy Creature
steps.text: Found it when the fowlbeast was singing.

steps.name: Agitated Creature
steps.text: How's the weather today?

steps.name: Dozy Creature
steps.text: All good until the bad happens.

steps.name: Agitated Creature
steps.text: Time is of the essence. Our party is about to begin.

steps.name: Agitated Creature
steps.text: Baa, why did you only arrive just now?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Me?

steps.name: Agitated Creature
steps.text: Say no more. I can tell at a glance that you're different from the other mediocre people.

steps.name: Agitated Creature
steps.text: I suggest you join our grand plan.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Grand plan? What are you going to do?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Where am I... And why am I wearing Mutti's clothes?

steps.name: Agitated Creature
steps.text: We will find what we like most, carry it on our backs, and never take it off again.

steps.name: Dozy Creature
steps.text: It is so very heavy, so heavy that I won't be able to straighten my back, but it is very important!

steps.name: Agitated Creature
steps.text: Why do you have nothing on your back?

steps.name: Dozy Creature
steps.text: No, no, she does have it on her back!

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Good evening, child. Did you hear the bell?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Bell? No... But that might be because I can't hear very well most of the time...

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Then, you should also come and join our party.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Where is it?

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: When next the bell rings, at the end of the world.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: But before that, I have something to show you.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Mmhmm. It looks like my memory is correct.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: These stones, specimens, and red-colored photos. These are what you've been brought here to see.
The gentle creature walks forward with light footsteps.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Look, these rocks have been alive for thousands, tens of thousands of years. They were buried here, deep beneath the ground, long before even we were here.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: They are so beautiful, so passionate. Though they were deep underground, hundreds of miles apart, they eventually came together and brought forth a marvelous eruption.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: You love them, don't you?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Volcanoes? I do...

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Volcanoes or rocks, they are all very precious treasures.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: But, my dear Adele...

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: What if someone used them to do bad things? What would you do?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Bad things? Like what?

steps.name: Agitated Creature
steps.text: A pretty nice party it was ♪

steps.name: Dozy Creature
steps.text: A pretty nice party it'll be ♪

steps.name: Agitated Creature
steps.text: The North Wind we've found, we've found ♪

steps.name: Dozy Creature
steps.text: But where are the seeds in the ground, the ground ♪

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Oh, the party's about to begin.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Adele, would you like to bring a rock to the party?

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Then, let us make haste.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: What's wrong? What's on your mind?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Um... I'm sorry to say this, but I...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Little Black Sheep... Are you Mr. Dolly?

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: I am Dolly, but I am also not Dolly.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Who I am depends on what I am in your mind.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: There are some differences between you and Mr. Dolly.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Are all of those... Little Black Sheep?

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: No, no. We cannot say 'all.' Each and every one is unique, as is their connection to the world.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Just as we refer to you, we would not call all of them 'Adele.'

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Every 'Adele' is unique.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: So, why did you invite me here?

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Because of the North Wind.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Because we wished to share the joys of harvest. Every participant in this party has been chosen.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Including you, my dear Adele.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: The things I've experienced the last few days have truly been mind-boggling.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: That, too, is a part of life.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Are you happy right now, little one?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I don't know...

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Let me take a look. I believe you are...

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: ...not very happy right now.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Look over there. She is the proof.
The Little Black Sheep look down from atop the chest.
A tiny, fragile creature tries to jump up – once, twice... Try as it might, it cannot jump onto the chest.

steps.name: Tiny Creature
steps.text: Hrmm...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Is it alone?

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: She looks very weak right now. Too weak to jump.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Can we help her out?

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Not right now.

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Only when the volcano erupts will she become herself.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Is she also one of your kind?

steps.name: Gentle Creature
steps.text: Yes. Eventually, everyone will become one of us.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Mornin', Adele. Would you like some breakfast?

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: Why do you look so tired? Want me to make you a cup of coffee?

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: Good morning...

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: I seem to have had a really long and strange dream last night, and I'm still a bit out of it.

steps.name: Enis
steps.text: You know what they say around here? The emotions that overflow too much during the day are left over for you to savor in your dreams at night.

steps.name: Adele
steps.text: What was the dream about again? I seem to remember something about it being very noisy and lively...

steps.name: Excited Girl
steps.text: It's true! I really saw it all!

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: Yes, yes. I believe you.

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: And because of that, you're not allowed to have ice cream for two months for sneaking out of your room and midnight and sneaking over to the land by the sea.

steps.name: Ice Cream-Craving Girl
steps.text: Aww...

steps.name: Indignant Girl
steps.text: But, I saw a little lamb run into my room last night, and it took me to a place where there were a whole bunch of other lambs...

steps.name: Indignant Girl
steps.text: There were a whole bunch of lambs, as fluffy as marshmallows, singing and dancing on top of a chest...

steps.name: Harley
steps.text: If what you say is true, a flock of sheep invited you to join their midnight party.

steps.name: Indignant Girl
steps.text: Yeah, I think that makes sense. Because I've been a good girl...
A complete mess.
Up until yesterday, specialty products from various countries shipped by MountainDash Logistics had all been stockpiled here.
If nothing unexpected happened, they would have appeared at the trade fair in a few days to show the tourist city what the outside world looked like.
But now, there are overturned shelves everywhere the eye can see, goods strewn haphazardly across the ground, dusty footprints stamped atop some of them.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: How... did this happen...?
